mapper.select: SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.qna.mapper.selectQnaDetail */ A.qstn_sn AS qstnSn , A.pst_ttl AS pstTtl , A.qstnr_nm AS qstnrNm , A.rls_yn AS rlsYn , A.pst_cn AS pstCn , A.pst_inq_cnt AS pstInqCnt , A.atch_file_id AS atchFileId , A.thmb_id AS thmbId , A.del_yn AS delYn , A.rgtr_id AS rgtrId , TO_CHAR(A.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDt , A.mdfr_id AS mdfrId , TO_CHAR(A.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdfcnDt , A.qstn_prgrs_stts_cd AS qstnPrgrsSttsCd FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_qna A WHERE A.qstn_sn = #{qstnSn} AND A.del_yn = 'N' AND A.bbs_id = #{bbsId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.qna.mapper.selectQnaAnswer */ A.ans_sn AS ansSn , A.qstn_sn AS qstnSn , A.ans_cn AS ansCn , A.ans_id AS ansId , A.ans_nm AS ansNm , A.use_yn AS useYn , A.rgtr_id AS rgtrId , A.reg_dt AS regDt , A.mdfr_id AS mdfrId , A.mdfcn_dt AS mdfcnDt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_qna_ans A LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_mngr_info M ON M.emp_no = A.ans_id LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info E ON E.emp_no = M.emp_no WHERE A.qstn_sn = #{qstnSn} AND A.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('kids_own.sq_cm_qstn_sn')
/* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.qna.mapper.insertQna */ INSERT INTO kids_own.tb_cm_m_qna ( qstn_sn , pst_ttl , qstnr_nm , rls_yn , pst_cn , pst_inq_cnt , atch_file_id , thmb_id , del_yn , rgtr_id , reg_dt , mdfr_id , mdfcn_dt , qstn_prgrs_stts_cd , bbs_id ) VALUES ( #{qstnSn} , #{pstTtl} , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '사용자') , COALESCE(#{rlsYn}, 'N') , #{pstCn} , 0 , #{atchFileId} , #{thmbId} , 'N' , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '사용자') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '사용자') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{qstnPrgrsSttsCd}, '01') , #{bbsId} )

SELECT nextval('kids_own.sq_cm_ans_sn_1')
/* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.qna.mapper.insertQnaAnswer */ INSERT INTO kids_own.tb_cm_m_qna_ans ( ans_sn , qstn_sn , ans_cn , ans_id , ans_nm , use_yn , rgtr_id , reg_dt , mdfr_id , mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( #{ansSn} , #{qstnSn} , #{ansCn} , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '-') , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '-') , 'Y' , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '-') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '-') , NOW() )
mapper.update:
/* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.qna.mapper.updateQna */ UPDATE kids_own.tb_cm_m_qna
pst_ttl = #{pstTtl},
pst_cn = #{pstCn},
rls_yn = #{rlsYn},
atch_file_id = #{atchFileId},
thmb_id = #{thmbId},
mdfr_id = #{mdfrId},
qstn_prgrs_stts_cd = #{qstnPrgrsSttsCd},
mdfcn_dt = NOW()
WHERE qstn_sn = #{qstnSn}
